SECRET

NICHI NICHI
FABRICATED DOCUMENT ENTITLED "MAJOR-GENERAL
MATSUMURO'S MEMORIAL" ISSUED TO ANTI-JAPANESE
CLIQUE BY KUOMINTANG

The National Salvation
Associations and the Popular Front have published in
their organs and in left-wing publications a fabricated
document entitled "A draft memorial of Major-General
Matsumuro, Chief of the Special Military Organ at Peiping."

It contains a plot to invade
North China and plans to be carried out in this connection.
It is sufficient to attract the attention of the panic-
stricken people and even leading persons are inclined to
believe that it is genuine.

It is reported that this document
was written by a Chinese well-versed with Japanese affairs
and subsequently sold at a high price to the Chinese Military
Authorities. Later, it was handed over to the Central
Authorities who, in turn, secretly passed it to a member
of the Popular Front, who immediately translated and
published the text.

In view of the fact that a
translation of the memorial has appeared in the organs of
the Popular Front, it has been clearly established that
the anti-Japanese organizations are intimately connected
behind the scenes with the Kuomintang which pretends to have
no connection with them.

《日日新闻》
题为“松室少将奏折”的伪造文件由国民党发给反日派系

全国救国会和人民阵线在其机关刊物及左翼出版物上刊登了一份题为《北平特务机关长松室少将奏折草案》的伪造文件。

其中包含入侵华北的阴谋以及为此目的而制定的计划。这足以引起惊慌失措的民众的注意，甚至领导人也倾向于相信它是真实的。

据报，这份文件是由一名精通日本事务的中国人撰写，随后以高价出售给中国军方当局。后来，它被移交给中央当局，中央当局又秘密将其转交给人民阵线的一名成员，该成员立即翻译并公布了文本。

鉴于人民阵线的机关刊物上出现了该奏折的译文，可以明确证实，反日组织在幕后与国民党有着密切的联系，而国民党表面上假装与它们没有关联。

quiry.—Domei.

英日军官会谈

东京武官会见松室将军

北平，10月27日电。——今天上午，日本天津驻屯军特务部部长松室 T. 少将与日本驻东京大使馆武官 F. S. G. Piggott 少将在会晤中讨论了加强日本与英国在华北友好关系的问题。

这位英国军官昨天从满洲国抵达此处，计划今晚前往日本。

据同盟社从可靠消息来源获悉，两位军官讨论的话题之一是去年5月26日晚在此地哈德门街发生的满洲国国防部雇员佐佐木喜作（Kisaku Sasaki）被杀案。

当地日本当局将此人之死归咎于三名英国士兵，然而，英国调查法庭判定这三名士兵无罪。——同盟社。

Made by ____________________ and ____________________ Forwarded by C.D.I. Ross

I forward herewith a photographic copy of a pamphlet
in Chinese, together with full translation, which contains an
alleged secret intelligence report made by Major General
Matsumuro to the Japanese Kwantung Army. Copies of this pamphlet
were recently privately distributed among local higher class
Chinese, but enquiries so far have failed to trace the origin of
the handbill or the place where it was printed. It is not known
whether the report itself is a genuine document or otherwise.
It has been suggested, however, that it is the work of certain
persons closely related to the National Salvation Movement, and
in this connection it is interesting to note that issues Nos.
20 and 21 dated October 4 and 11 respectively of the "National
Salvation Intelligence" (救亡情報) reproduced Major General
Matsumuro's report in full. The "National Salvation Intelligence"
is the official organ of the following five bodies :-
Shanghai Cultural Circles National Salvation Association
Shanghai Women's National Salvation Association
Shanghai Vocational Circles National Salvation Association
Shanghai University Professors' National Salvation Association
Shanghai National Crisis Educational Society.
The Social Daily News on October 15, 16 and 17
published a series of three articles by one Zau Zu Zung (曹聚仁)
commenting on Major General Matsumuro's report. Zau Zu Zung,
member of the University Professors National Salvation Association,
is a professor in the Fuh Tan University, Kiangwan, where a
number of students were once actively engaged in the local
national salvation movement.

D. R.

兹随函附上中文小册子的摄影副本及完整译文，其中包含据称由松室少将向日本关东军提交的秘密情报报告。该小册子的副本最近在当地上层华人中私下分发，但目前的调查未能追踪到该传单的来源或印刷地点。尚不清楚该报告本身是否为真实文件。不过，有人指出，这是某些与救亡运动密切相关的人士所为，在此方面值得注意的是，《救亡情报》第20期和21期（分别 dated 10月4日和11日）全文转载了松室少将的报告。《救亡情报》是以下五个团体的官方机关刊物：
上海文化界救国会
上海妇女救国会
上海职业界救国会
上海大学教授救国会
上海国难教育社。
《社会日报》在10月15日、16日和17日连载了三篇由曹聚仁（Zau Zu Zung）撰写的文章，评论松室少将的报告。曹聚仁是大学教授救国会成员，也是江湾复旦大学的教授，该校曾有许多学生积极参与当地的救亡运动。

SECRET
Japanese Major General Matsumuro's Recent Confidential
Intelligence Report to the Kwantung Army.
----------
A. The Smuggling Problem.
The smuggling of the products of the Empire into China
is a drastic measure adopted by the Empire in dealing with
China. This step is taken for the purpose of accelerating
the formation of a special political body in North China
under the sole influence of the Empire, so that the solution
of all political, economic and military problems can be
accomplished in accordance with its wishes.
(1) Materials and Markets.
The gradual expansion of the Empire's industrial productions
and their penetration into the world market in recent years have
incurred the jealousy of the European countries and America,
which have, one after another, created tariff barriers in their
own territories and their dominions to prevent the sale of our
Empire's products. The Empire did think of adopting retaliative
measures towards the products of those countries concerned, but
those products are mostly requisite raw materials needed by the
Empire and cannot be substituted by our own products. The
lack of raw materials and the narrowness of the markets are
acutely felt, and so also the need of a hard struggle for the
acquisition of raw materials and markets. The territories
acquired for such purposes cannot be safely protected without
their co-operation with the Empire's efforts. Thus came the
occupation of Mukden on September 18, 1931, which afforded a
temporary relief to the Empire's need for markets and raw
materials. But there are certain other raw material problems
which Manchuria cannot solve or which Manchuria can possibly
solve only after years of hard labour and cultivation. Now
the Manchurian market has been ripe and cannot be further
expended within a short period of time. It cannot therefore
be compatible with the rate of the Empire's growth, and in
order to ensure the safety of Manchuria the Empire is bound

A. 走私问题。
将帝国产品走私进入中国，是帝国对华采取的严厉措施。采取这一步骤的目的是为了加速在帝国独家影响下在华北形成一个特殊的政治实体，以便按照帝国的意愿解决所有政治、经济和军事问题。
(1) 原料与市场。
近年来，帝国工业生产的逐步扩张及其向世界市场的渗透，引起了欧洲国家和美国的嫉妒，这些国家相继在其本土及其领地设立关税壁垒，以防止帝国产品的销售。帝国确实考虑过对相关国家的产品采取报复措施，但这些产品大多是帝国必需的原材料，无法用我们自己的产品替代。原材料的缺乏和市场的狭窄令人深感紧迫，因此为获取原材料和市场而进行的艰苦斗争也是必要的。为此目的获得的领土，若无配合帝国的努力，便无法得到安全保护。于是有了1931年9月18日对沈阳的占领，这暂时缓解了帝国对市场 and 原材料的需求。但是，满洲还有一些其他原材料问题无法解决，或者可能只有在经过多年的辛勤劳作和开发后才能解决。目前，满洲市场已经成熟，无法在短时间内进一步扩展。因此，它与帝国的增长速度不相适应，为了确保满洲的安全，帝国必须

（左侧竖排手写字：此次企图期望其成功）

to make every effort towards the creation of a buffer zone
bordering on Manchuria.

The problem of the Empire's dense population and its
high birth rate cannot be solved without industrial
development, which needs the safeguarding of an adequate
amount of raw materials and sufficient markets. The
acquisition of new raw materials and markets is therefore
a big enterprise on which the prosperity of the Empire
depends. According to the Manchurian and Mongolian principles
as embodied in the Empire's Continental Policy the occupation
of Manchuria must be followed by the acquisition of Mongolia.
Mongolia occupies a most strategic point from a military point
of view and should be acquired by all means, for which purpose
the Empire has made unceasing efforts. But Mongolia is only
a barren plain and its resources need long periods of investi-
gation and development and cannot relieve the present urgent need.
The Mongols lead a primitive life. The development of the
market within a short space of time cannot be expected.
Furthermore, those Japanese trained for Mongolian work are
still under primary tuition and the primitive living in the
barren plain does not suit the average Japanese. On the other
hand the close watch kept by the Soviet Russia increases the
cautiousness of the Empire. Besides adopting all kinds of
underhand methods to coerce and make a tool of the Mongol Princes
the Empire does not contemplate any occupation that may stimulate
the nerves of an enemy country. Thus the Empire cannot help
turning its eyes on the easily accessible North China for the
solution of its need for raw materials and markets. A scrutiny
of the raw materials and markets of North China follows:-

Market & Population. The population of Hopei, Shantung,
Shanse, Chahar, Suiyuan, Shensi and Honan (half) is about
100,000,000, three times as big as that of Manchuria and its
wasting potentialities thrice bigger as well. Merchandises
are imported mostly through Tientsin and Tsingtao.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

竭尽全力在与满洲接壤的地区建立缓冲区。

帝国人口稠密和高出生率的问题，若不通过工业发展是无法解决的，而工业发展需要充足原材料和足够市场的保障。因此，获取新的原材料和市场是一项关乎帝国繁荣的大业。根据帝国大陆政策中体现的满蒙原则，占领满洲之后必须获取蒙古。从军事角度来看，蒙古占据着最具战略意义的地位，必须不惜一切代价获取，为此帝国做出了不懈的努力。但蒙古只是一片贫瘠的平原，其资源需要长期的调查和开发，无法缓解当前的迫切需求。蒙古人过着原始的生活。不可能指望在短时间内开发市场。此外，那些受过蒙古工作训练的日本人仍处于初级学习阶段，而在贫瘠平原上的原始生活并不适合普通日本人。另一方面，苏联俄罗斯的严密监视增加了帝国的谨慎。除了采取各种暗中手段胁迫并利用蒙古王公作为工具外，帝国不打算进行任何可能刺激敌国神经的占领行动。因此，帝国不得不将目光转向易于接近的华北，以解决其对原材料和市场的需求。以下是对华北原材料和市场的审视：

市场与人口。河北、山东、山西、察哈尔、绥远、陕西和河南（一半）的人口约为1亿，是满洲人口的三倍，其浪费潜力也是满洲的三倍。商品主要通过天津和青岛进口。

- 3 -

Raw Materials. North China is the center of raw
materials which comprise a large quantity of coal, iron,
wheat, cotton and petroleum. The quantity of coal is only
next to that of America and occupies the second place in
the world. The quantity of coal under the ground of Shansi
calculated at half the amount will be 120 times as much as
that of the Fu Shun coal. There is about 200,000,000 tons
of iron ore under the ground. The four provinces of Sansi,
Shantung, Hopei and Chahar produce 110,000,000 piculs of
wheat, 3,300,000 piculs of cotton and 50,000,000 piculs of
beans. The production of raw materials can possibly be
as
increased thrice/much under the organised direction and control
of the Empire in the future, and the people's wasting poten-
tialities can also be greatly increased, so North China will
truly be the best new colony of our Empire.

Political Problems.

In consequence of the failure of the autonomous movement
started by the Empire and the success of the East Hopei
independence the Empire has had to suit the needs of the day
by adopting the scheme of smuggling as an effective and urgent
coersion. Its purpose is to export large quantities of the
Empire's products to relieve the dumping of surplus productions
and take over the markets from Great Britain, America and other
countries, bringing about a general lowering of prices of
commodities in the whole of North China. Such a scheme not
only puts a stop to the sale of European and American products
but is also welcomed by the populace. It will also increase
the wasting and purchasing potentialities of the people and
nourishes and enables the ronins, vanguards of the Empire, to
enter deep into the interior of North China and carry out special
activities. The Empire should utilise pro-Japanese elements as
tools for the eradication of influential cliques, extend its
control over North China and make the officials and people
cherish a general scare of the Empire. The Empire should also
resort to smuggling and bribery to test the character of the

原材料。华北是原材料的中心，包括大量的煤、铁、小麦、棉花和石油。煤炭储量仅次于美国，居世界第二位。如果按一半计算，山西地下的煤炭储量将是抚顺煤炭的120倍。地下约有2亿吨铁矿石。山西、山东、河北和察哈尔四省生产1.1亿担小麦、330万担棉花和5000万担豆类。在未来帝国的有组织指导和控制下，原材料产量有可能增加两倍/三倍，人民的浪费潜力也可以大大增加，因此华北将成为帝国最好的新殖民地。

政治问题。

由于帝国发起的自治运动失败以及冀东独立的成功，帝国不得不顺应时势，采取走私方案作为一种有效且紧急的胁迫手段。其目的是出口大量帝国产品，以缓解过剩产品的倾销，并从英国、美国和其他国家手中夺取市场，导致整个华北商品价格普遍下降。这样的方案不仅阻止了欧美产品的销售，也受到民众的欢迎。它还将增加人民的浪费和购买潜力，滋养并使作为帝国先锋的浪人能够深入华北内地，开展特殊活动。帝国应利用亲日分子作为铲除有影响力派系的工具，扩大对华北的控制，并使官员和百姓对帝国产生普遍的恐惧。帝国还应利用走私和贿赂来测试

of the officials. The present smuggling preventive measures
adopted by China are foolish and ridiculous. If China takes
drastic action, the Empire can do nothing, for protection by
force can only result in strengthening the spirit of resistance
of the people of North China. Judging from the present
circumstances the people who all scare us will by no means dare
to cause any hindrance. We should continue the adoption of
the coercive policy so as to put them under our sway permanently.
The present increase of troops, apart from its military signi-
ficance, has the effect of securing a victory without fighting.
It can be predicted that the North China political independent
movement is only a matter of form. If the Empire achieves its
aim, it should not push to its extreme. The exports into North
China, with only a slight coercion, will receive the most
favoured treatment. In that case the Empire's exportations
will be greatly active.

Customs Tariff.

The more the smuggling the greater the loss on China's
tariff will be, so the policy of smuggling can be employed to
coerce China to accord a most favoured tariff towards us.
There now seems to be possibilities of China's giving way in
the matter.

Chinese Officials and People.

The Wisdom of the influential Cliques. What the Empire
can feel comforted is the Chinese officials general scare of
Japan and their reluctance to resort to resistance.

Seventy percent of North China cannot unite and co-operate.
Individualism and the principle of self-preservation are rampant.
It prolongs its life under the principle of not offending the
Empire. Those individual and independent petty groups care
only for their own momentary profits and cannot naturally resist
the attack by the Empire. Their selfishness affords unusual
facilities to the Empire which can gain a victory without
fighting and obtain anything it requires. This does not apply
to the late Chang Tsoh Ling whose words were actions and who did
not care about diplomacy and international relations or in the
pages.zh:
- 4 -

官员们。中国目前采取的走私预防措施愚蠢且可笑。如果中国采取激烈行动，帝国也无可奈何，因为武力保护只会增强华北人民的抵抗精神。 judging from the present circumstances（从目前的情况来看），那些令我们畏惧的人绝不敢制造任何阻碍。我们应该继续采取强制政策，以便将他们永久置于我们的控制之下。目前的增兵，除了其军事意义外，还具有不战而胜的效果。可以预见，华北政治独立运动只是形式上的。如果帝国达到其目的，不应将其推向极端。输往华北的出口货物，只需稍加强制，即可获得最惠待遇。在这种情况下，帝国的出口贸易将大大活跃。

海关关税。

走私越严重，中国的关税损失就越大，因此可以利用走私政策来胁迫中国给予我们最惠关税。目前看来，中国在此事上让步的可能性是存在的。

中国官员与民众。

有影响力派系的智慧。令帝国感到欣慰的是，中国官员普遍惧怕日本，且不愿诉诸抵抗。

华北百分之七十的地区无法团结合作。个人主义和自保原则盛行。他们在不冒犯帝国的原则下苟延残喘。那些各自为政的小团体只关心眼前的利益，自然无法抵抗帝国的进攻。他们的自私为帝国提供了非凡的便利，使帝国能够不战而胜并获得所需的一切。这不适用于已故的张作霖，他言行一致，不在乎外交和国际关系，也不适用于

case of Ma Chuan Shan who knew his strength being insufficient
but who still offered stubborn resistance. In such cases the
Empire should act cautiously so as to avoid heavy losses and
should not exert its pressure to the extreme. It needs greater
discretion to find out whether Sung (General Sung Cheh Yuen)'s
subordinates are pro the Empire's policy. It must be borne in
mind that Chinese troops who usually lose in formal fighting
may become formidable enemies to the Empire's troops when
scattered as bandits.

Chinese influential cliques are mostly selfish and adherents
of individualism. They lack patriotism. Thus it gives rise to
the existence of independent districts, dictators and keeping of
personal troops. They do not care for the existence of the
nation nor the suffering of the people. Their craving for
political aggrandisement and materialism is extraordinarily great
and their aim is to maintain their existing status in order to
satisfy their wishes. They do not like to see their influence
crushed. Patriotic officials are very few. The majority care
only for themselves and not for others, and their strength is
hardly sufficient to suppress re-actionary activities. How can
they talk about resistance against Japan? Their greediness
causes them to degenerate in their spirits. They cannot withstand
enticement and coercion. This can be proved by the success
achieved in the Foochow incident and the concessions obtained
in the different parts of China. In future the Empire's policy
towards China will be to crush big opponents and maintain petty
ones so as to decentralise their strength and stir up jealousy
among them.

The peculiar characteristic of the Chinese officials and
people is that their patriotism lasts only five minutes. Some
people even do not know what their nation is. The majority of
the officials and people are selfish, care only for their homes
and are even willing to do evil to their country. Their motive
is to satisfy the greedy wishes of an individual or a group.

- 5 -

马占山的情况，他明知力量不足，但仍顽强抵抗。在这种情况下，帝国应谨慎行事，以避免重大损失，且不应将压力施加到极限。需要更加审慎地查明宋（宋哲元将军）的部下是否支持帝国的政策。必须牢记，通常在正规战中失利的中国军队，一旦分散成为匪徒，可能会成为帝国军队的劲敌。

中国有影响力的派系大多自私且信奉个人主义。他们缺乏爱国心。因此导致了独立区域、独裁者以及私人武装的存在。他们不关心国家的存亡，也不关心人民的苦难。他们对政治扩张和物质主义的渴望极其强烈，其目的是维持现有地位以满足其愿望。他们不喜欢看到自己的影响力被粉碎。爱国官员寥寥无几。大多数人只关心自己而不关心他人，他们的力量几乎不足以镇压反动活动。他们怎能谈论抗日呢？他们的贪婪导致其精神堕落。他们无法抵挡诱惑和胁迫。福州事件的成功以及在中国各地获得的让步证明了这一点。未来，帝国对华政策将是打击大对手，维持小对手，以分散他们的力量并挑起他们之间的嫉妒。

中国官员和民众的一个奇特特征是，他们的爱国主义仅持续五分钟。有些人甚至不知道自己的国家是什么。大多数官员和民众是自私的，只关心自己的家庭，甚至愿意危害自己的国家。他们的动机是为了满足个人或团体的贪婪愿望。

pages.en:
- 6 -

They do not care about the welfare of the nation or the
country. Though there is a small minority who strive to
better the welfare of the general public, they belong to
the oppressed class who can scarecely keep their body and
soul together and can help very little. In future the
Empire should utilise the aristocratic class to oppress
the patriotic elements.

Speaking of the masses in North China they are cunning
and weak-minded and easily yield to seducement or coercion.
They lack organisation and training and just like sands. But
a small part of anti-Manchurian and anti-Japanese influences
continues, after repeated failures, to fight with us. In
spite of repeated pacifications, expeditions and military and
political endeavours it still constitutes a stubborn enemy of
the Empire. The anti-Japanese elements and students in North
China, though in some way organised and resolute in their
purpose, mostly come from other parts and can hardly penetrate
into the local masses. On the outbreak of trouble they will
surely break up and cannot constitute a real menace. As they
possess a deep hatred against Manchuria and Japan, they will
undoubtedly organise and train anti-Japanese groups on their
return to their native places, which will become a stubborn
enemy to the Empire. For this reason the Empire should avoid
stirring up their ill feeling by pressing those holding **〔此处转录不清〕**
power in North China to adopt suppressive measures towards their
activities and by refraining from direct interference.

The Activities of the Ronins.

The dignity and power of the Empire's troops have made a
deep impression on the minds of the Chinese officials and people,
so the activities of our people in North China meet very little
hindrance. The Chinese officials and people seldom interfere
with the unlawful activities of the majority of the ronins nor
do they protest to the Empire's officials. Thus the ronins'
activities become unusually effective, and the incompetency of the
Chinese authorities is becoming more apparent, increasing the
people's hatred and despair towards the officials and turning their
pages.zh:
- 6 -

他们不关心国家或民族的福祉。虽然有一小部分人努力改善公众福利，但他们属于受压迫阶级，几乎难以维持生计，能提供的帮助微乎其微。未来，帝国应利用贵族阶级来压迫爱国分子。

谈到华北的民众，他们狡猾且意志薄弱，容易屈服于诱惑或胁迫。他们缺乏组织和训练，如同一盘散沙。但一小部分反满抗日势力在屡遭失败后，仍继续与我们战斗。尽管进行了多次绥靖、征讨以及军事和政治努力，他们仍然是帝国的顽固敌人。华北的抗日分子和学生，虽然在某种程度上有组织且目的坚定，但大多来自其他地区，很难渗透到当地民众中。一旦发生动乱，他们肯定会瓦解，无法构成真正的威胁。由于他们对满洲和日本怀有深仇大恨，他们在返回家乡后无疑会组织和训练抗日团体，这将成为帝国的顽固敌人。因此，帝国应避免通过迫使掌握 **〔此处转录不清〕** 权力的华北当局对其活动采取镇压措施，并避免直接干涉，从而激起他们的反感。

浪人的活动。

帝国军队的威严和权力给中国官员和民众留下了深刻印象，因此我们在华北的人员活动遇到的阻碍很小。中国官员和民众很少干涉大多数浪人的非法活动，也不向帝国官员提出抗议。因此，浪人的活动变得异常有效，中国当局的无能也日益明显，增加了民众对官员的仇恨和绝望，并将他们对

the Empire no longer needs their activities which should be
completely suppressed. It is not so with North China where
the ronins enjoy greater freedom in their activities than
they do in Manchuria, so the ronins in the interior and
Manchuria all flock to North China. Their contribution
to the Empire cannot be neglected.

Legitimate Japanese subjects are well acquainted with
Sino-Japanese disputes and care more for their lives and
property. They are not willing to run risks in China, and
their movements are confined to important ports. They do
not dare engage in illegitimate business. The ronins, on
the contrary, have no family worries, are possessed of a
daring spirit, and utilise Chinese traitors and co-operate with
them. As these ronins enjoy the protection of the Empire, they
are, of course, faithful to the Empire and are ready to run any
sort of risk when ordered to do so. The Empire adopts a
tolerant attitude towards their movements, while China lacks
the audacity to take suppressive measures. In case of their
unlawful activities exceeding their bounds they are to be sent
back to their country in the name of loafers. Such an act
does not impair the dignity of the Empire.

The Chinese officials' scare of Japan can be seen from their
method in dealing with smuggling. Now we turn to the better
organised Customs. The foreign Customs officials have weakened
in their attitude, not to say Chinese and other officials. The
ronins can therefore carry on their activities under the
protection of just a handful troops and police, no big force
being required. In case should Chinese authorities be
determined to adopt effective suppressive measures, the Empire
should not go too far to protect them.

Though the main force of the Communist Army has returned to
the northern part of Shensi, it is feared that it may enter

帝国军队的仇恨转化为厌恶和钦佩。在帝国控制下的整个满洲不再需要他们的活动，这些活动应被完全取缔。但华北情况不同，浪人在那里的活动自由度高于在满洲，因此内地和满洲的浪人都涌向华北。他们对帝国的贡献不容忽视。

合法的日本臣民熟悉中日纠纷，更关心自己的生命和财产。他们不愿意在中国冒险，其活动局限于重要港口。他们不敢从事非法业务。相反，浪人没有家庭后顾之忧，拥有大胆的精神，并利用中国叛徒与他们合作。由于这些浪人享有帝国的保护，他们当然忠于帝国，并准备在接到命令时承担任何风险。帝国对他们的活动采取宽容态度，而中国缺乏采取镇压措施的胆量。如果他们的非法活动越界，将以无业游民的名义将他们遣送回国。这种行为不会损害帝国的尊严。

中国官员对日本的恐惧可以从他们处理走私的方式中看出。现在我们转向组织更好的海关。外国海关官员的态度已经减弱，更不用说中国和其他官员了。因此，浪人可以在仅由少量军队和警察的保护下进行活动，无需大规模兵力。万一中国当局决心采取有效的镇压措施，帝国不应过度保护他们。

<u>共产党军队与共产党员。</u>

虽然共产党军队的主力已返回陕西北部，但担心其可能进入

Chahar and Suiyuan towards Manchuria and unite with Soviet
Russia against Japan. This the Empire should not neglect.
This Red Army is very strong and possesses high fighting
capacity. Its spirit of endurance in hardship surpasses
that of any modern army and its principles penetrate deep
into the minds of the people. As China has no big capitalists
and has only petty farmers and labourers, the people easily give
way to their seducement. This Army started from Kiangse and
roved through South, Central and West China towards North China.
They fought thousands of miles and suffered unprecedented
hardships. Though it experienced unusual oppression from
the material point view, its spirit is, nevertheless, very
high. Its entry into Shanse has enabled it to obtain an
adequate supply of materials and its strength has again become much
stronger. They are every ready to take advantage of opportune
circumstances and the psychology of the Chinese people by carrying
out a propaganda against Japan. The future strength of the
Army should not be neglected.

In view of the deterioration of the politics in the
country, the lack of hope of a military and economic revival,
the lack of determination on the part of the Government to
resist Japan and its ever readiness to yield, the majority of
the Chinese youths have, under the joint motive of resisting
Japan, recovering lost territories and preserving the country's
existence, joined the Communist Party and acted as their
vanguards. They hide in North China and are extremely active.
They are in unison with the Communist Army in Manchuria. If
extended and strengthened in the future they will be a serious
menace to the Empire. In the Empire the industrial and
commercial development has created a class struggle between
the capitalists and labourers. In case of lack of raw materials
or narrowness of the markets with the consequent unemployment
the people are liable to be misled by the Communists. The
ambition of the proletarians and the poverty of Manchurians
and Koreans are both taken as good opportunities for the
Communists.

察哈尔和绥远，朝向满洲方向，并与苏联联合对抗日本。帝国不应忽视这一点。这支红军非常强大，拥有很高的战斗力。其吃苦耐劳的精神超过任何现代军队，其原则深入人心。由于中国没有大资本家，只有小农和劳工，民众容易屈服于他们的诱惑。这支军队从江西出发， traversed（穿越）华南、华中和华西，向华北进发。他们转战数千里，遭受了前所未有的苦难。虽然从物质角度看经历了异常的压迫，但其士气依然高昂。进入山西使其获得了充足的物资供应，实力再次大大增强。他们随时准备利用有利时机和中国民众的心理，开展反日宣传。不应忽视该军队未来的实力。

鉴于国内政治的恶化，军事和经济复兴缺乏希望，政府缺乏抗日的决心且随时准备屈服，大多数中国青年在抗日、收复失地和保存国家生存的共同动机驱使下，加入了共产党并充当其先锋。他们潜伏在华北，极其活跃。他们与满洲的共产党军队保持一致。如果未来得到扩展和加强，他们将对帝国构成严重威胁。在帝国，工商业的发展造成了资本家与劳工之间的阶级斗争。如果缺乏原材料或市场狭窄，从而导致失业，民众容易被共产党人误导。无产阶级的野心以及满洲人和朝鲜人的贫困都被共产党人视为良机。

In short the Communist Army is a formidable enemy to
the Empire's troops. Any army in the world needs large
sums for the payment of soldiers and material equipment.
In other words lack of money will rock its foundation, and
without material supply the consequences will be disastrous.
The Communist Army is an exception. They live a simple life
and carry out-of-date weapons without an adequate supply of
ammunition. They depend on the Communist policy, guerrilla
warfare, appropriate propaganda, clever organisation and
training in thoughts to secure the sympathy of the oppressed
and to form into a big collective group with a defatiguable
and unbending spirit. This Communist Army is more efficient
than that in Manchuria and is suitable for fighting in poverty
stricken districts and prolonged guerrilla warfare, when major
hostilities are inadvisable. In this case it is advantageous
for the Empire's Army to be on the defensive instead of on the
offensive and to prevent the spread of their propaganda and
their guerrilla attacks in the rear.

Pretexts.

If the Empire wants to seize a pretext to start its
operations in China, it can be found at any time and place.
It is ridiculous to see that the Chinese officials and people
are all afraid of offending Japan. It thus reveals the dignity
of the Empire which should by no means lose the opportunity
to seize special privileges. Now comes the problem of vanguards
who have, in the name of experts, joined the political, military
and economic fields under the control of the North China authori-
ties. Their knowledge will be a great advantage to the Empire's
policy.

B. Work in China.

The Empire's policy in dealing with China will be Chinese
to control Chinese. The Empire's occupation of Manchuria without
military force (?) saved a lot of worries. Loafers and influential
cliques should be utilised to form autonomous and independent
political groups. The first step is to protect North and North

简言之，共产党军队是帝国军队的劲敌。世界上任何军队都需要巨额资金来支付军饷和装备物资。换言之，缺乏资金将动摇其根基，而若无物资供应，后果将是灾难性的。共产党军队则是一个例外。他们生活简朴，使用过时的武器，弹药供应也不充足。他们依靠共产党的政策、游击战、适当的宣传、巧妙的组织以及思想训练，以赢得被压迫者的同情，并形成一个具有不知疲倦和不屈精神的大型集体。这支共产党军队比在满洲的军队更为高效，适合在贫困地区作战并进行长期的游击战，尤其是在不宜进行大规模敌对行动的情况下。在这种情况下，帝国军队采取守势而非攻势是有利的，以防止其宣传在后方的传播及其游击袭击。

借口。

如果帝国想寻找在中国发动行动的借口，随时随地都能找到。可笑的是，中国官员和民众都害怕得罪日本。这反而彰显了帝国的尊严，帝国绝不应错失攫取特权的机会。现在的问题是那些以前锋自居的人，他们以专家的名义，加入了受华北当局控制的政治、军事和经济领域。他们的知识将对帝国的政策大有裨益。

West China.

(1) The people in North China lack organisation and
are cunning in disposition. Their resistance is feeble.
As North China is the place for solving the Empire's
problem of raw materials and markets and as Chiang Kai
Shek adopts an indifferent attitude towards North China,
the Empire, in consequence of the Continental Policy,
should not be satisfied with the present status.

(2) The North West (Suiyuan and Mongolia) is for the
greater part barren plains, and the Mongolian officials and

(3) As North China and North West China are situated on

(a) To create one trouble after another in China so as

(b) To break the union between China and Soviet Russia

(c) To prevent the entry into the North East of any

(d) To safeguard north China and north West China thus

Then the individual independent political bodies will all be
under the control of the Empire.

There is great hope of the Empire's success in its work
in China by adopting the formula of gaining a victory without
fighting. If the Chinese officials and people openly resist

西北地区。

(1) 华北民众缺乏组织，性情狡诈。他们的抵抗力微弱。由于华北是解决帝国原材料和市场问题的地方，且蒋介石对华北采取漠不关心的态度，因此，作为大陆政策的结果，帝国不应满足于现状。

(2) 西北（绥远和蒙古）大部分是贫瘠的平原，蒙古官员和民众容易被诱骗并置于帝国军队的控制之下。

(3) 由于华北和西北地区位于满洲边境，应将它们建成缓冲区，这在军事上具有巨大价值。

(a) 在中国制造一个又一个麻烦，使其逐渐失去收复失地的希望。

(b) 打破中国与苏联在反日共同战线上的联合。

(c) 防止在紧急时刻有任何势力进入东北。

(d) 保卫华北和西北地区，从而为迫使华东、华中和华南屈服并逐步消灭中国政府铺平道路。届时，各个独立的政治实体都将处于帝国的控制之下。

通过采取“不战而胜”的策略，帝国在华工作大有成功希望。如果中国官员和民众公开抵抗日本，帝国将担心受到苏联和国际反应来自后方的威胁。开战后，各地的骚乱和遍布全国的大量匪徒将成为帝国棘手的问题，帝国在华官员、民众和士兵的损失将是巨大的。破坏后的重建几乎无法指望。此外，共产党军队、中国军队以及满洲官员和民众对日本的深仇大恨，将对帝国的胜利构成巨大危险。必须牢记，帝国在九一八事变（1931年9月18日）后在华战役中屡获胜利，是由于中国依赖国联而采取的不抵抗政策。由于缺乏自觉性和对对手的了解，中国军队在受到帝国军队威胁时变得惊慌失措，患上了“恐日病”。帝国施加的压力越大，中国就越恐惧，“恐日病”也就越严重。如果那时中国官员和民众能够团结起来进行抵抗，帝国在满洲的影响力将陷入深渊。帝国能否获得原材料供应、处置其产品、利用其资源、维持如此广阔的领土并控制如此庞大的人口，是大成问题的。如果反满抗日力量能够联合起来并进行大规模骚乱，帝国军队将不知所措。时代已经改变，但反日影响仍在各地存在。因此，帝国在未来对华交往中应努力使以下各项成为现实：

(1) 威胁和胁迫有影响力的派系，以确保不战而胜。
(2) 避免使用武力镇压有影响力的派系，从而节省不必要的损失。
(3) 严密监视中国所有当权者，

people can unite together to resist, the Empire's influence

The Social Daily News (社會日報) published on October

Zung (曹聚仁) :-

THE CONFIDENTIAL REPORT OF MAJOR GENERAL MATSUMURO

I.

A reading of the confidential report
submitted by Major General Matsumuro to the Japanese
Kwantung Army has convinced us of the genuineness of the
article. The three sections dealing respectively with
Chinese officials, the Communist Army and the Communist
Party and the activities of Japanese in China, particularly
his conclusions, deserve our serious attention.

Major General Matsumuro said in his
report: "Ever since the September 18 Incident, the Empire
has gained victories in China without fighting. China at
first adopted a policy of non-resistance in the hope of
securing assistance from the League of Nations. Later
she over-estimated the strength of the Imperial Army and
began to suffer from a general malady of fear of Japan.
The more China was coerced by the Empire, the more she
became afraid and the more serious this malady became."

In the opinion of Major General Matsumuro,
had China resolved to put up a resistance and united all
the anti-"Manchukuo" and anti-Japanese forces to under-
take an extensive guerrilla warfare, the Japanese army would
have been hard put to maintain its position. He therefore
made the following six suggestions:

(1) That the parties in China that have real power be
coerced and intimidated by threats of force, so that
Japan may win victories without fighting.

(2) That no attempt be made to smash the power of these
parties by means of armed force for it would bring
unnecessary loss upon Japan.

(3) That these parties be closely watched and prevented

《社会日报》于1936年10月15日刊登了由曹聚仁撰写的以下社论：

松室少将的秘密报告

I.

阅读松室少将提交给日本关东军的秘密报告后，我们确信该文章的真实性。报告中分别涉及中国官员、共产党军队和共产党以及日本人在华活动的三个部分，特别是其结论，值得我们认真关注。

松室少将在报告中说：“自九一八事变以来，帝国在中国不战而胜。中国起初采取不抵抗政策，希望获得国联的援助。后来她高估了皇军的实力，开始普遍患上恐日病。帝国对中国胁迫越甚，中国就越恐惧，这种病症也就越严重。”

在松室少将看来，如果中国决心抵抗，并联合所有反“满洲国”和反日力量开展广泛的游击战，日军将难以维持其地位。因此，他提出了以下六项建议：

(1) 以武力威胁胁迫中国拥有实权的各派，以便日本不战而胜。

(2) 不要试图用武力粉碎这些派系的权力，因为这会给日本带来不必要的损失。

(3) 严密监视这些派系，防止

from being so united as to lead to the formation of
a united front against Japan.
(4) That strict precautions be taken against the formation
of alliances between China with Soviet Russia or
Great Britain or the United States so as to enable
her to resist Japan.
(5) That steps be taken to prevent joint action to resist
Japan by the forces of the Feng Yu Hsiang clique
(meaning the troops under Generals Sung Cheh Yuan
and Han Fu Chu), the soldiers under Generals Yen Hsi
San and Chang Hsueh Liang and the Red Army in North
Shensi.
(6) That parties which are the most seriously affected
by fear of Japan be given support and directed to
suppress all anti-Japanese elements.
The **〔此处转录不清〕** purpose of the above suggestions,
of which the last is the most practical, is to enable
Japan to win victories without fighting.
In connection with their ambitious designs
upon China, the Japanese Imperialists are finding the
following five problems most difficult of solution:
(1) Will the extension of Japanese influence to the
Yangtsze Valley and the Pearl River Valley be allowed
to go unopposed by Great Britain and the United States?
(2) Will Japan be able to dissolve the union once the
National Government has succeeded unifying the whole
country?
(3) Will not the expansion of the Red Army in the Northwest
result in that army being in a position to form a
united front for a direct conflict with the Japanese
forces in Mongolia, Suiyuan and Chahar?
(4) With the waking up of the Chinese parties that are in
power, will the fear of Japan die out?
(5) Will the Chinese traitors be as active in Central and
South China as they are in North China?

(4) 严防中国与苏联、英国或美国结盟以抵抗日本。
(5) 采取措施，防止冯玉祥派系（指宋哲元和韩复榘将军麾下的部队）、阎锡山和张学良将军的士兵以及陕北红军联合行动抵抗日本。
(6) 支持受恐日病影响最严重的派系，并指导他们镇压所有反日分子。
上述建议的目的是使日本不战而胜，其中最后一条最为切实可行。**〔此处转录不清〕**
关于日本帝国主义对中国的野心勃勃的计划，他们发现以下五个问题最难解决：

From the confidential report of Major General
Matsumuro, we see that Japan is already finding it
difficult to maintain her policy of winning victories
without fighting. Instead of obtaining property without
capital, they now have to invest a huge amount of
capital. We regard this as a turning point in China's
policy towards Japan and hope that the National
Government will continue in this direction.

The Social Daily News published on October 16, 1936, the
following editorial written by Zau Zu Zung:-

THE CONFIDENTIAL REPORT OF MAJOR GENERAL MATSUMURO

II.

In his analysis of the Chinese people and government
officials alike, Major General Matsumuro states in his report:
"Our Empire rejoices that there prevails among the Chinese
officials a universal fear of Japan, which has brought them
to such a condition that they dare not commit the slightest
offence against this Empire. Most of the Chinese powerful
parties are in the habit of working for their own glory and
prosperity or for the glory and prosperity of their own
cliques; they have no consideration for the nation and people.
This resulted in seizure of control of a place and "owning"
of troops privately. These parties also have a strong
desire for political power and material profits; so if they
can maintain existing conditions to satisfy their desires,
they will be unwilling to use their strength. The Empire
should aim at breaking up these large parties and support
the small parties so as to prevent centralization of their
power and to create suspicion and jealousy among the parties."

That which rejoices Japan hurts our hearts.
However, we have to admit that his analysis is very accurate
and true. The fear of Japan is the least found among
the masses, but prevails generally among the propertied class
and those high-class Chinese who are dependent upon them.
In short, the prevalence of this malady varies in proportion
to the station in life and the wealth of a person. Those
who are in possession of great power and wealth are satisfied
so long as they can remain so. We may say that the fear
of Japan is similar to that prevailing among the wealthy

松室少将的秘密报告

II.

在分析中国民众和政府官员时，松室少将在报告中指出：“帝国欣喜地看到，中国官员中普遍存在恐日情绪，这使得他们不敢对帝国有丝毫冒犯。大多数中国有权势的派系习惯于为自己的荣耀和繁荣，或为其自身派系的荣耀和繁荣而工作；他们不考虑国家和人民。这导致了对地方的控制和私人‘拥有’军队。这些派系也对政治权力和物质利益有强烈的渴望；因此，如果他们能维持现状以满足其欲望，他们就不愿使用自己的力量。帝国应以瓦解这些大派系、支持小派系为目标，以防止其权力集中，并在各派系之间制造猜疑和嫉妒。”

careful of this fear of Japan.

Major General Matsumuro made the following
conclusion about our people: "The people of North China
are cunning and weak-minded; they may be easily induced
or coerced into doing something ..... Although the anti-
Japanese elements and students in North China are to some
extent organized and resolved in mind, they come mostly
from other parts of China and cannot influence the masses
of North China. In case of trouble, they will soon dissolve
and need not be taken into serious account."

We do not admit this false picture of the people
of North China. The people referred to in the statement
of Major General Matsumuro are the people under the control
of local bullies and corrupt gentry and therefore cannot
be representative of the true people. In the rural villages,
the local bullies and corrupt gentry are like devils; to
corrupt government officials, they are like the claws and
teeth of a tiger. In times of alien aggression, they
become first class traitors. The words "cunning" and
"weak-minded" are suitable terms applied to them. This is
proved by historical events. We admit that the words of
Major General Matsumuro are correct in so far as the local
bullies and corrupt gentry are concerned.

But we must not be too pessimistic. There are
signs that the fear of Japan has come to an end among our
people and leaders. As Major General Matsumuro has said,
the regular Chinese army frequently loses when engaged in
real fighting, but when they are disbanded and become bandits,
they instantly become strong opponents of the Imperial Army.
The fear of Japan exists only among leaders, not among the
soldiers. All soldiers and true people of China are resolve
to oppose Japan. Let us not lose hope!

他们对罗马凯撒的恐惧。因此，我们应当警惕这种对日本的恐惧。

松室少将（Matsumuro）对我国人民作出了如下结论：“华北人民狡诈且意志薄弱；他们很容易被诱导或胁迫去做某事 ____ 。尽管华北的反日分子和学生在一定程度上有组织且决心坚定，但他们大多来自中国其他地区，无法影响华北的广大民众。一旦发生动乱，他们很快就会瓦解，不必予以重视。”

我们不承认这种对华北人民的错误描绘。松室少将陈述中所指的民众，是受地方恶霸和腐败士绅控制的民众，因此不能代表真正的人民。在乡村里，地方恶霸和腐败士绅如同魔鬼一般；对于腐败的政府官员来说，他们犹如虎狼之爪牙。在外敌侵略之时，他们便成为头等汉奸。“狡诈”和“意志薄弱”这些词用在他们身上是恰当的。历史事件证明了这一点。我们就地方恶霸和腐败士绅而言，承认松室少将的话是正确的。

但我们不应过于悲观。有迹象表明，我国人民和领袖中对日本的恐惧已经结束。正如松室少将所说，中国正规军在实战中经常失利，但当他们解散沦为匪徒时，立刻就成了帝国军队的强劲对手。对日本的恐惧仅存在于领袖之中，而不存在于士兵之中。所有士兵和中国的真正人民都决心反对日本。让我们不要失去希望！
